hero_kpi_rationale: Recurring, predictable revenue, and superior margins; this KPI is a key driver of enterprise valuation

kpis.name: Annual Recurring Revenue from subscriptions (ARR)
kpis.explanation: Recurring revenue from subscriptions and Pega Cloud services.
kpis.description: Recurring, predictable revenue, and superior margins.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin expressed as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: Gross margin, indicator of enterprise profitability.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin, indicator of enterprise profitability and operational efficiency.

kpis.name: Research and Development Expenses as a percentage of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Annual research and development expenses expressed as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: R&D investments, indicator of enterprise innovation and product development.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Annual capital expenditures for infrastructure and equipment.
kpis.description: Capital investments, indicator of efficiency and capital intensity of the enterprise business model.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees at the end of the period.
kpis.description: Total headcount, indicator of growth, organizational structure, and enterprise capacity.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 1.63 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 0.08 Bn € in the latest year
